title: Evaluation of the straight-line program
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean DAG circuit on $n$ inputs in which every gate has at most two arguments, and choose an input index $i_0\in\mathrm{Fin}\,n$. For every Boolean input assignment $x$, the straight-line program constructed from $C$ using $i_0$ has the same output as $C$.
